_comment: Who may be paged about a held position, and how the position is named (P1 2026-10-23, NVDA).
A moomoo account-opening reward (0.133 NVDA, $28, no cost basis) paged 'STOP HIT ... your plan stop' 31 times
since 2026-09-28 on a system entry-plan level. Operator, verbatim: 'Momo gave me that for free for opening my
account. Okay, so on these notices, we need to tag what account it came from.'
Edit here (no code change): de_minimis_usd, promo_max_usd, the two exclude_* switches, opt_in, promo_positions.
_opt_in_help: Positions that still get stop / exit pages although tiny or promo: "SYMBOL" (every account) or "account_key:SYMBOL".
